statement: I got one negative comment on my presentation. The whole thing was a disaster.
My model's accuracy dropped 0.5%. Everything I've worked on for the past month is worthless.
I stumbled over my words once in the interview. They will definitely not hire me.
I said something awkward at the dinner. Everyone thinks I'm socially incompetent.
The AI system made a mistake that hurt a user. I should never have built this.
I have twenty patents but no one knows who I am in the AI field.
I don't have a publications list as long as my peers. I'm behind academically.
I've spent fifteen years in industry and contributed nothing that will be remembered.

US taxpayers gave $400 billion to cable companies to build fibre internet across America. The companies took the money and built nothing. Therefore no corporation can ever be trusted with public funds.
I committed to exercising every day. I missed two days. The whole commitment is broken and I've proven I can't change.
Accepting my chronic pain means giving up. I refuse to accept it because that would mean defeat.
My childhood was traumatic. It's only a matter of time before I develop a serious mental illness.
